subject: SIG selection, evidence owners, and SOC 2 timeline
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@mediforge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG selection, evidence owners, and SOC 2 timeline

Hi Elena — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side so your security and procurement teams can triage: 

1) SIG vs CAIQ: We recommended starting with the SIG Lite + a couple of targeted CAIQ sections for cloud hosting and key management to speed review. If you need a full CAIQ later we can provide it, but SIG Lite usually gets Procurement through faster. Please confirm which form you prefer.

2) SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in-progress. Expected report availability: Sept 2026 (final audit window May–Aug). For now we can provide our SOC 2 Type I attestation, the SOC 2 audit plan, and interim controls documentation. 

3) HIPAA / GDPR: We support HIPAA (BAA available) and have EU region hosting options. We need to confirm whether MediForge requires EU data residency for this project or just GDPR compliance controls.

4) Evidence owners: To speed collection, please let us know the primary evidence recipients on your side (security contact + procurement). From our side:
   - Controls & SOC materials: kimberly_park@redwood.com
   - Hosting/network diagrams and KMS details: mateo@redwood.com
   - Contractual/BAA questions: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: org_chart_v2.pdf (team ownership map), redwood_network_diagram.png (high-level hosting + regions).

Proposed next steps: 
- You confirm form (SIG Lite vs full CAIQ) and evidence recipient emails by EOD Thu 5/14.
- We’ll prefill the SIG Lite with answers we control and mark fields for your review; expect the prefill in 48 business hours after confirmation.
- If you want a joint intake call we can schedule 30 minutes early next week.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

-----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@mediforge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mediforge.com, security@mediforge.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG selection, evidence owners, and SOC 2 timeline

Thanks Mateo — very helpful summary. A few clarifying points from Security/Procurement: 

- We’d prefer to start with SIG Lite + targeted CAIQ sections for KMS and encryption. If that goes well, we’ll request the full CAIQ for deeper ops review.
- SOC 2: Procurement will accept Type I plus interim controls for initial approval, but Security will want the Type II before production go-live. Please flag anything that might materially change controls between your Type I and the upcoming Type II.
- HIPAA: Yes, we will need a signed BAA before any PHI flows. Please send your standard BAA template.
- Evidence recipients: security@mediforge.com will be the primary; CC procurement@mediforge.com for contract items.

Can you also confirm whether your EU region keeps separate KMS keys per tenant? That’s a specific ask from our privacy team.

— Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Security Operations | MediForge

-----
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@mediforge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG selection, evidence owners, and SOC 2 timeline

Elena — thanks, got it. Quick answers: 

- SIG Lite + targeted CAIQ works. We’ll prefill SIG Lite and include the CAIQ fields for KMS/encryption and network segmentation.
- SOC 2: No planned control regressions between Type I and Type II. Kimberly will add a short memo summarizing changes between the two reports when the Type II is available.
- BAA: Karthik is looping legal; I attached our standard BAA draft for initial review (see related links). We’re happy to accept reasonable redlines for enterprise customers.
- EU KMS behavior: We support per-tenant KMS keying in EU regions; keys can be customer-managed via KMS provider integrations (Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS). I’ll add a diagram callout in the prefill where we describe KMS ownership and key rotation cadence.

Deliverables & timing: 
- SIG Lite prefill (with CAIQ snippets): ETA 48 business hours after you confirm — target Fri 5/16 EOD.
- BAA template sent to procurement and legal: same day.
- SOC 2 Type I package (if you need it now): will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder within 24 hours.

If that timeline works I’ll drop the prefill into the Drive folder and notify security@mediforge.com.

Cheers,
Mateo

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@mediforge.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG selection, evidence owners, and SOC 2 timeline

Hi Elena — quick note from legal and procurement ops: 

- We uploaded the BAA template to the Drive link shared below. Please review and flag any contractual terms that need negotiation; procurement@mediforge.com is on copy for commercial questions.
- We will prefill the SIG Lite and include pointers to where the SOC I evidence and KMS diagrams live. If security wants screenshots for IAM roles and VPC peering, Kimberly will coordinate a short evidence bundle (3–5 artifacts).
- For planning: if you confirm SIG Lite today we can have the prefill and evidence bundle in your Drive folder by Fri 5/16 at 17:00 PT. That should keep Procurement moving while Security completes the deeper review.

Link to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-Prep

Appreciate the collaboration — we’re flexible on the form selection but want to avoid a full CAIQ unless necessary to reduce review friction.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions & Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
